proof_roadmap.step: Assemble representability, separatedness, smoothness of the Hilb schemes
Prove properness and irreducibility via the degree d! finite locally free cover X^d -> Hilb^d
Prove the addition morphism is finite locally free of degree binom(d_1+d_2,d_1)

difficulty_reason: Prove the three-part structure theorem for Hilb^d of a geometrically irreducible smooth proper curve: representability from proposition-hilb-d-representable plus projectivity; separatedness (lemma-hilb-d-separated) and smoothness (lemma-hilb-d-smooth); build X^d -> Hilb^d by (x_1,...,x_d) |-> x_1 + ... + x_d via lemma-universal-object and induction, finite locally free of degree d!; properness of Hilb^d since X^d is proper and the morphism surjective onto its image (morphisms-lemma-image-proper-is-proper); irreducibility since X^d is irreducible (geometrically irreducible factors); part (2) is the point-divisor dictionary by definition; part (3): the addition morphism Hilb^{d_1} x Hilb^{d_2} -> Hilb^{d_1+d_2} is finite locally free of degree binom(d_1+d_2, d_1) by the commutative diagram with X^{d_1} x X^{d_2} = X^{d_1+d_2} and multiplicativity of degrees.
